Value.quote: Charter expects pro forma full year 2026 capital expenditures, excluding transition capital expenditures, to total approximately $13.0 billion.
Value.summary_en: Charter expects pro forma full year 2026 capital expenditures, excluding transition capital expenditures, to total approximately $13.0 billion.

Value.quote: the Company is targeting $2 billion in annualized run-rate operating expense savings over the next 18 months, in addition to more than $1 billion in anticipated Cox Transactions synergies.
Value.summary_en: Charter targets $2 billion in annualized run-rate operating expense savings over the next 18 months, plus more than $1 billion in Cox Transactions synergies.

Value.quote: On a pro forma basis, third quarter Spectrum MobileTM lines1 increased by 508,000 and by 1.8 million over the last twelve months.
Value.summary_en: Pro forma Spectrum Mobile lines increased by 508,000 in the quarter and by 1.8 million over the last twelve months.

Value.quote: During the quarter, Charter exchanged $5.5 billion in aggregate principal amount of secured notes for a combination of approximately $4.0 billion in cash and new secured notes, resulting in approximately $1.5 billion in deleveraging, and repaid $1.0 billion of legacy Cox notes at maturity.
Value.summary_en: Charter exchanged $5.5 billion of secured notes, resulting in approximately $1.5 billion in deleveraging, and repaid $1.0 billion of legacy Cox notes.

Value.quote: During the third quarter, Charter purchased 139,807 shares of Charter Class A common stock for $19 million.
Value.summary_en: Charter purchased 139,807 shares of Class A common stock for $19 million during the quarter.

Value.quote: On August 19, 2026, Charter completed its transactions between the Company and Cox Communications, Inc. ("Cox Communications") (the "Cox Transactions").
Value.summary_en: Charter completed the Cox Transactions on August 19, 2026.
